title: FTC Sends More Than $449,000 to Consumers Harmed by ‘Extended Vehicle Warranty’ Scam
summary: FTC press release reporting refund checks sent to tens of thousands of consumers harmed by the same extended-vehicle-warranty telemarketing scam.

assertions.quote: pretended to represent car dealers and manufacturers
made false claims that its products offered "bumper to bumper" protection
sending more than $449,000 in refunds to consumers who were harmed by American Vehicle Protection Corp.

verdicts.note: This is the FTC's own reported refund distribution from a completed settlement.

assertions.quote: the FTC is sending checks to 18,255 consumers

verdicts.note: The FTC reports refunds reaching tens of thousands of consumers in this settlement, indicating the scam's scale.

assertions.quote: Recipients should cash their checks within 90 days, as indicated on the check.

verdicts.note: A time-limited check-cashing window is standard FTC refund-distribution practice, stated directly in the release.
